title: Delegate Saga work through bounded, repeatable operations
statement: As a change author, I can let an automated assistant inspect and update the Saga through bounded, deterministic operations, so that large documentation work stays safe and repeatable.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Every structured read returns a stable success or error envelope.
Each paginated read reports whether more results remain.
A cursor is rejected when the Saga changes beneath it.
A batch mutation writes nothing when any requested change is invalid.
Repeating a mutation request ID does not create duplicate records.
Structured reads do not execute embedded Saga content.
Automation can ask whether only its selected coverage areas are complete.
A failed coverage check reports gaps only from the selected areas.
